description: Save a PDF copy of the document with a PDF preset (e.g. "[High Quality Print]", "[PDF/X-4:2008]"), optionally overriding its compatibility, PDF/X standard, image compression and downsampling, font subsetting, bleed, printer's marks, colour conversion, output intent, transparency flattening, passwords and permissions, thumbnails and Acrobat layers (Save Adobe PDF dialog). The document must be saved first; it is reopened afterwards so you keep working on the .ai file

acrobatLayers.description: Make Acrobat layers from top-level layers (acrobat6 or later)

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

bleed.description: Bleed on every side, in points

colorConversion.description: none; convert_to_destination; or preserve_numbers (convert only colours with a different profile)

flattener.description: Transparency flattening, used with compatibility acrobat4 (PDF 1.3). Give a preset or custom settings

gradientResolution.description: Custom: gradient and mesh resolution, ppi

lineArtResolution.description: Custom: line art and text resolution, ppi

strokesToOutlines.description: Custom: convert all strokes to outlines

textToOutlines.description: Custom: convert all text to outlines

fontSubsetThreshold.description: Subset fonts when less than this percent of their characters is used

images.description: Compression panel: downsampling and compression per kind of image

compression.description: none, zip_8bit, zip_4bit, jpeg_<quality>, jpeg2000_<quality>, automatic_jpeg_<quality> or automatic_jpeg2000_<quality>; quality is minimum, low, medium, high or maximum (JPEG 2000 also lossless)
none, zip_8bit, zip_4bit, jpeg_<quality>, jpeg2000_<quality>, automatic_jpeg_<quality> or automatic_jpeg2000_<quality>; quality is minimum, low, medium, high or maximum (JPEG 2000 also lossless)
none, ccitt_group3, ccitt_group4, zip or run_length

markOffset.description: Distance between the artboard and the marks, in points

marks.description: Printer's marks to add: trim, registration, color_bars, page_info, or all. An empty list removes them

openAfterSaving.description: Open the PDF in the default PDF viewer afterwards. Default false

outputIntent.description: PDF/X output intent profile name, e.g. "Coated FOGRA39 (ISO 12647-2:2004)"

preserveEditability.description: Keep Illustrator editing data in the PDF. Default false

preset.description: PDF preset name as Illustrator lists it. Default "[High Quality Print]". The options below override it

security.description: Passwords and permissions. 40-bit with compatibility acrobat4, otherwise 128-bit. Not allowed with a PDF/X standard

allowCopy.description: Allow copying text, images and other content (40-bit: copying and screen-reader access)

allowScreenReaders.description: Allow text access for screen readers (128-bit)

changes.description: Changes allowed: 128-bit takes none, edit_pages, fill_forms, commenting, any; 40-bit takes none, page_layout, commenting, any

openPassword.description: Require this password to open the document

permissionsPassword.description: Require this password to change the permissions below

standard.description: PDF/X standard. A PDF/X preset sets this and the matching compatibility for you

name: export_pdf
title: Export PDF
